_comment: Relational algebra → SQL golden cases. RelationalAlgebraTests/ReverseTranslationTests.swift checks the app produces exactly `sql` from `ra`; scripts/check_engines.py runs `sql` on DuckDB and DataFusion and checks `answer`.

cases.name: select-project
ascii-aliases
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM Employee
WHERE salary > 50000
  AND dept_id = 1;

cases.name: latex-export
theta-join-renames
cases.ra: π[e.name, d.name → department] ( ρ[e](Employee) ⋈[e.dept_id = d.id] σ[d.location = 'Berlin'](ρ[d](Department)) )
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.name, d.name AS department
FROM Employee AS e
JOIN Department AS d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.location = 'Berlin';

cases.name: product-then-select
cases.ra: π[Student.name] ( σ[Student.sid = Enrolled.sid ∧ Enrolled.cid = 10] ( Student × Enrolled ) )
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT Student.name
FROM Student, Enrolled
WHERE Student.sid = Enrolled.sid
  AND Enrolled.cid = 10;

cases.name: natural-join
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name, title
FROM Student
NATURAL JOIN Enrolled
NATURAL JOIN Course;

cases.name: difference
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM Student
NATURAL JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Student
  EXCEPT
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Enrolled
) AS t1;

cases.name: union
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM Employee
WHERE dept_id = 1
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM Employee
WHERE salary > 65000;

cases.name: nested-set-operations
cases.sql:
(
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Student
  EXCEPT
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Enrolled
)
UNION
(
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Enrolled
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Student
);

cases.name: self-join-rename-attributes
cases.ra: π[s1, s2] ( σ[s1 < s2] ( ρ[A(s1, c1)](Enrolled) ⋈[c1 = c2] ρ[B(s2, c2)](Enrolled) ) )
cases.sql:
WITH A(s1, c1) AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM Enrolled
),
B(s2, c2) AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM Enrolled
)
SELECT DISTINCT s1, s2
FROM A
JOIN B ON c1 = c2
WHERE s1 < s2;

cases.name: left-outer-join
right-join-keeps-filter-below
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT salary, location
FROM (
  SELECT *
  FROM Employee
  WHERE salary > 50000
) AS t1
RIGHT JOIN Department ON dept_id = Department.id;

cases.name: product-then-outer-join
cases.ra: π[name, title, Enrolled.cid] ( (Student × Course) ⟕[Student.sid = Enrolled.sid ∧ Course.cid = Enrolled.cid] Enrolled )
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name, title, Enrolled.cid
FROM Student
CROSS JOIN Course
LEFT JOIN Enrolled ON Student.sid = Enrolled.sid AND Course.cid = Enrolled.cid;

cases.name: selection-above-projection
delta
derivation-read-once-is-inlined
cases.ra:
R₁ = σ[salary > 50000](Employee)
R₂ = π[R₁.name, location](R₁ ⋈[dept_id = Department.id] Department)
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT Employee.name, location
FROM Employee
JOIN Department ON dept_id = Department.id
WHERE salary > 50000;

cases.name: name-read-twice-becomes-cte
cases.ra:
E := π[sid, cid](Enrolled);
π[A.sid](σ[A.sid = B.sid ∧ A.cid < B.cid](ρ[A](E) × ρ[B](E)))
cases.sql:
WITH E AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sid, cid
  FROM Enrolled
)
SELECT DISTINCT A.sid
FROM E AS A, E AS B
WHERE A.sid = B.sid
  AND A.cid < B.cid;

cases.name: derived-table-keeps-the-name
cases.ra:
S ← π[sid](Student) − π[sid](Enrolled)
π[name](σ[Student.sid = S.sid](Student × S))
cases.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM Student, (
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Student
  EXCEPT
  SELECT DISTINCT sid
  FROM Enrolled
) AS S
WHERE Student.sid = S.sid;
